Just copy the snippet below into a terminal (or your preferred HTTP client) and replace `YOUR_KEY_FOUR` with the actual API key you referred to as **“key_four.”**

```bash
curl -X POST \
     https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes \
     -H "x-apikey: YOUR_KEY_FOUR" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'
```

**What this does**

| Part | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/22.242.75.136/votes` | Endpoint for voting on the specific IP address. |
| `-H "x-apikey: YOUR_KEY_FOUR"` | Authenticates the request with your API key. |
| `-H "Content-Type: application/json"` | Tells VirusTotal that the body is JSON. |
| `-d '{"type":"vote","attributes":{"verdict":"malicious"}}'` | The payload you supplied – it tells VT that you consider the IP malicious. |

**Response**

```json
      "created_at": "2026-07-08T12:34:56Z",
      "updated_at": "2026-07-08T12:34:56Z"

  }
}
```
